source_note: PARSEC publishes no isochrone packages: the official CMD web form (https://stev.oapd.inaf.it/cgi-bin/cmd) computes isochrone tables server-side on request and is the isochrone acquisition channel (scriptable with a complete current field set, verified live 2026-10-14; complete wire documentation: docs/parsec/cmd-form.md). The host's TLS chain omits its intermediate CA (ZeroSSL RSA DV SSL CA 2); the bundled intermediate completes the chain so verification stays on.
scope_note: Form-computed isochrone products (request-layer client: stellariso.models.parsec.cmd_form). Every track-set combination the form accepts, over its full [M/H] window, on a 0.1 dex composition grid and fine log-age grids; option variations that change only auxiliary columns are fetched once each at a representative composition. Historical pre-2006 tracks on pleiadi.oapd.inaf.it remain out of scope.

matrix_notes.ages: log10(age/yr) 6.6-10.13; 0.02 dex for the current physics sets, 0.05 dex for secondary sets, 0.1 dex for option variations; the server interpolates intermediate ages itself
matrix_notes.metallicities: one product per [M/H] on a 0.1 dex grid (single-value jobs; range end points are unreliable server-side)
matrix_notes.photometry: placeholder only: YBC UBVRIJHK for YBC-served sets, OBC/odfnew LSST for the older sets (the YBC library does not carry them)
matrix_notes.extinction: A_V = 0 everywhere; extinction changes magnitudes only (verified 2026-10-15, docs/parsec/cmd-form.md)
matrix_notes.skipped_options: dust compositions and bolometric-correction versions affect magnitudes only; kind_postagb has a single accepted value; v1.1/v1.0 outputs carry no release echo (identity release 'unknown')
